title: Rule of Zero vs Rule of Five
prompt: `Config0` already obeys the Rule of Zero — leave it alone. Implement all five special members of `Lease` over its owning `int*`: deep copy, guarded assignment, noexcept steals.

tests.name: Rule of Zero needs nothing
tests.hint: Do nothing — the implicit members copy the int correctly. Do not add any special member declarations.

tests.name: Lease deep-copies
tests.hint: new int(*o.resource_) — deep copy, never share the pointer.

tests.name: Lease steals on move
tests.hint: Steal the pointer, null the source: resource_(std::exchange(o.resource_, nullptr)).
